_comment: Fixture di PROVA dell'harness runtime (R2/R3, 06/08) -- NON un output di melting-gen. Vive qui e non in generated/visualspecs/batch.json apposta: quel path e' di produzione, lo riscrive `bin/melting-gen --visualspecs`, e nella sessione del 06/08 un giro vero di R1 ha sovrascritto a meta' lavoro la fixture che i controlli DRY_RUN stavano usando -- e' cosi' che un disallineamento sul significato di 'free_prompt' fra i due cantieri e' passato inosservato per un'intera sessione. Un harness che si prova da solo deve avere un ingresso che nessun altro processo tocca. I free_prompt qui sotto rispettano il contratto PRECISATO: prompt SD COMPLETI (vista + soggetto + resa + soggetto singolo + sfondo grigio piatto), perche' a valle del braccio 'free' non esiste nessun template -- vedi la testata di tools/melting-gen/gen_visualspec.h.

spec.distinctive_feature: a lantern-shaped hollow where the face would be

requests.free_prompt: Seen from a top-down three-quarter angle, a tall narrow figure wrapped in ash-grey cloth over bronze and verdigris plating, a lantern-shaped hollow where its face would be. One single subject alone in frame, on a flat solid neutral gray background.

spec.distinctive_feature: a split shell that shows the glowing seam underneath

requests.free_prompt: Top-down three-quarter view of a low wide four-legged creature of cooled slag and cracked slate, dusted with soot, its split shell showing a glowing seam underneath. A single subject alone in frame on a flat solid neutral gray background.

spec.distinctive_feature: a second smaller blade folded along the spine

requests.free_prompt: Top-down three-quarter view of a long curved worn-bronze blade with a wrapped leather grip, a second smaller blade folded along its spine, tip pointing right. The weapon is isolated, alone in frame, on a flat solid neutral gray background.

spec.distinctive_feature: a wax seal still unbroken over the spout

requests.free_prompt: Top-down three-quarter view of a small squat bronze barrel banded with cracked slate, an unbroken wax seal over its spout. A single object, isolated and alone in frame, on a flat solid neutral gray background.
